title: error "the condition has length > 1" in $.proto
description:
I am experiencing issues using prototypes when I set a proto variable with a function.
If the function is one-line function it works but in the case it is defined as literal in multiple lines it goes to an error in resolving $.proto

The error reported is

 Error en if (deparse(substitute(x)) %in% c(".that", ".super")) return(res): 
  the condition has length > 1

The %in% expression is failing when the result of parse is more than one line...

If the expression is changed to 

if (deparse(substitute(f1),nlines=1) %in% c(".that", ".super")) return(res)

the error is not reported here and works in cases of multiline functions passed literally in an argument.
